stories.headline: 1 dead after big rig carrying J. Cole's concert equipment crashes along Interstate 5 in Yolo County - KCRA
stories.summary: One person is dead after a big rig that was carrying concert equipment for musician J. Cole crashed and overturned along Interstate 5 in Yolo County on Thursday morning.
